gogpt_prior_assessment: GOGPT's 'Wuhu Xinxing power station' (120 MW, captive=True per GOGPT, 3.53 km) is NOT this terminal's captive plant — it is Wuhu Xinxing Ductile Iron Pipes Co (苜湖新兴铸管), a state-owned steel/pipe manufacturer under Xinxing Jiahua Group, whose own 55MW cogeneration unit burns blast-furnace/converter/coke-oven gas (industrial byproduct gas, not natural gas) recovered from its own steelmaking process: '由中冶京诚总承包的苜湖新兴铸管有限责任公司55MW煌气发电项目汽轮发电机组一次性并网成功' (55MW coal-gas power generation project, one-time successful grid connection, July 2021). This is a classic industrial-host trap: different owner (a steel manufacturer, not the LNG terminal operator) AND different fuel category (blast-furnace/coke-oven gas, not LNG-sourced natural gas). Separately, Huaihe Energy Group (the LNG terminal's own parent group, Huaihe Energy Gas Group) is building a 2×450MW gas-steam combined-cycle PEAKING power plant at the same Sanshan port area (深河能源苜湖天然气调峰电厂, approved May 2024, groundbreaking Oct 2024) — this is plausibly fed BY regasified gas piped FROM the Wuhu Changjiang LNG terminal (a PowerPlantsSupplied-direction relationship, not captive TO the terminal); flagged in notes for a different batch, not staged here.
